text:
riley: quick FYI — planning a rolling rollout for runtime service v2.4.1 tonight. start 2026-03-18 22:00 UTC, planned finish ~02:00 UTC. freeze window 21:30–02:30 UTC. please read below for risks/checklist.

riley: high-level plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m watch checks between phases. automatic rollback on error-rate >2% or P95 latency spike >200ms.

riley: expected risk: cold KV cache warmup may spike token-latency for first ~30m; model warm start on some GPUs may show 1–2 larger tails. also a cfg change to prefix-cache TTL (short) that might evict more entries.

samir: ack, I'll take the oncall ownership for the rollout window. riley — handing over at 21:45 UTC. I'll be primary in this thread and on pager.

maya: adding eng-sre and runtime runbook links: https://go/runbook/runtime-rollout. please ensure tracing tag rollout_id=v2.4.1 is present for all requests.

alex_c: I'll act as fallback platform contact for infra autoscale and capacity. I'll watch node memory and GPU utilization dashboards.

zach: assigning rollout-watchers: samir (primary), maya (sre), alex_c (platform), riley (backup). paging policy: pager triggers on infra/perf-alerts only during canary. :thumbsup:

riley: preflight checklist (short):
- merge gating PRs ✅
- smoke test in staging passed (staging-2026-03-17 18:02) ✅
- DB migrations: none
- index rebuild scheduled: NO, just config tweak
- obs: ensure retention for traces set to 48h for debug

samir: quick commands to verify health during canary:
- curl -sS 'https://runtime.internal/health' | jq .status
- kubectl -n runtime rollout status deployment/runtime --watch
- tail logs: stern runtime --since 10m | grep -Ei "error|warn"

maya: note — if cache eviction causes >10% error on retried requests, escalate immediately. we want to avoid noisy retries generating a storm.

samir: will set a short-lived metric alert: alert: RuntimeCanaryErrors rate() > 0.02 for 2m -> notify #eng-oncall and page samir.

riley: small post-deploy task: kick warmup job: `python tools/warmup.py --targets=all --parallel=8` after 25% step.

deploy-bot: Canary started: v2.4.1 -> 5% (2026-03-18 22:05 UTC)

samir: monitoring p95, error-rate, and token-latency. linking dashboards: https://dash/realtime/runtime?env=prod

alex_c: I'll keep an eye on node autoscale and quota. if we hit GPU throttles, plan fallback to smaller batch-size profile.

zach: FYI — org-wide deploy freeze for unrelated services between 23:45–00:30 UTC. runtime is exempt but be aware for cross-team ops.

samir: any volunteers to hold the post-mortem notes? riley can draft, or I can grab if riley busy.

riley: I can draft a short note and post in #postmortems after rollout.

maya: all good from SRE side. will keep traces and flamegraphs ready.

zach: one last ask — tag any anomalous traces with `tag:rollout_v2.4.1` so we can filter.

samir: signed on. will update this thread with phase changes and final status.

deploy-bot: Canary promoted to 25% (2026-03-18 22:25 UTC)

samir: 25% steady at 22:36 UTC, no notable errors, p95 +10ms. proceeding to 60% in 10m unless Maya requests hold.

maya: hold lifted. proceed. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary promoted to 60% (2026-03-18 22:46 UTC)

samir: full rollout started at 23:05 UTC. monitoring.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% (2026-03-18 23:25 UTC)

samir: rollout complete, metrics look stable. handing back oncall to riley at 23:40 UTC. riley: you're back as primary.

riley: back oncall, thanks all. I'll publish the quick rollout notes and follow-ups in #eng-release later tonight. :rocket:
